a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly fails. We would both still be at 0 when the first storm hits. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I'm breaking our agreement and taking 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If you also take, the split is random. If you operate or wait, I'll give back anything over 4 and will operate with you afterward.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. I won't take any more. From next round I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I'll give back anything over 4.
